title: Kowloon Rising Revisited
author: Zephyrine Ashgrove
blurb: Theo Thornbury, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
